Core Algorithms: Quicksort, Binary Search, BFS, DFS
Each implementation includes detailed comments explaining the logic,

from collections import deque
from typing import List, Optional, Tuple


# =============================================================================
# 1. QUICKSORT
# =============================================================================

def quicksort(arr: List[int]) -> List[int]:
    """
    Quicksort (functional / non-in-place variant).

    Strategy:
        1. Pick a "pivot" element (here we use the last element for simplicity).
        2. Partition the array into three groups:
             - elements < pivot
             - elements == pivot
             - elements > pivot
        3. Recursively sort the < and > partitions, then concatenate.

    Time Complexity:
        - Average case : O(n log n)
        - Worst case   : O(n²)  (already-sorted input with bad pivot choice)
